entities.summary: Under French, a notable figure in the history of Grenada, associated with French and British Colonial Era (1650–1763). Preceded by French Plantation Colony. Their legacy influenced Treaty of Paris cedes Grenada to Britain 1763 and Introduction of nutmeg cultivation to Grenada.
